events.title: Sirobagarh Chronic Landslide Complex
events.description: One of the most persistent landslide zones in Uttarakhand. Fragile phyllite slopes collapsed during heavy monsoon rain, blocking NH-7 for over 48 hours.

events.title: Chamoli Rock Avalanche & Debris Surge
events.description: Massive hanging glacier and rock detachment caused catastrophic flash flooding and riverbank scour, washing away bridges and damaging highway retaining walls along NH-7.

events.title: Pipalkoti Highway Boulder Slip
events.description: Sudden failure of weathered quartzite cliff sent house-sized boulders crashing onto the highway, stranding over 1,200 pilgrimage vehicles.

events.title: Tangani / Gulabkoti Slide Zone
events.description: Active landslide zone triggered by toe erosion from the Alaknanda River, continuously eroding the mountain slope under the highway.

events.title: Byasi Gorge Rockfall
events.description: Steep rocky canyon face failure following intense monsoon precipitation, obstructing traffic between Rishikesh and Devprayag.

events.title: Nandprayag Confluence Highway Slip
events.description: Cloudburst-triggered debris flow inundated the highway carriageway with 3 meters of mud and tree trunks.

events.title: Teen Dhara Debris Flow
events.location: NH-7 Between Devprayag and Teen Dhara
events.description: Overnight cloudburst sent tons of loose mountain slurry over roadside dhabas and damaged 150m of tarmac.
